description: Five generated styling proposals for the NetBet MAX character exhibition. These are not official game title assets.
generation_mode: Built-in image_gen, five independent calls in one parallel batch; one candidate per scene; no retries.
image_editing: All five deliverables are direct copies of generated originals. No shields or other image edits have been applied.
coordinate_system: Chest emblem centers measured on each exact 1536×1024 original. Percentages are relative to the entire uncropped image, origin top-left. width_percent is the recommended official shield width as a percentage of original image width. Apply translate(-50%, -50%) around the center. These are placement targets, not existing official shield positions.
integration_note: Keep visible caption 'Generated styling proposal' in the exhibition. Existing navy readability gradient through x43%, fading by x56%, addresses minor copy-zone encroachment. The mobile crop x44.4–100% preserves every Max silhouette.

assets.label: Generated styling proposal
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: generated styling proposal for a NetBet MAX landing-page BACKGROUND ENSEMBLE, landscape 1536x1024. Produce one complete raster scene. This is character art only, not a page mockup.
Input images: Image 1 is the binding identity reference for Max: match his mature charismatic face, swept-back sculpted silver hair, thick black rectangular glasses, white pointed beard and moustache, warm witty expression, slender elegant build and long legs. Images 2 and 3 are supporting Max wardrobe/material/rendering references only; DO NOT copy their left-sided composition. Images 4 and 5 define the secondary Egyptian queen, red-bearded folklore leprechaun, and blonde Norse warrior identities and 3D visual style; use only the requested characters, never their text, shields, logos, coins, XP emblems or layout.
Composition: all figures form an ensemble only within RIGHT HALF x50%–95%. Max is recognizable main ambassador integrated into environment depth, standing FULL-LENGTH centered near x71%, height 78% of the canvas, hair around y12% and both shoe soles around y90%, with clear floor contact and full silhouette. Keep entire hair, both shoes, hands and long coat inside frame. Supporting figures stand several paces behind him, distinctly smaller, softer-focus and dimmer, arranged around x56%–62% and x85%–91%, never competing with Max. Make the LEFT 44% from top to bottom uninterrupted very dark midnight navy #07152c, with only faint atmospheric tonal variation; no objects, silhouettes, architecture edges, plants, coins, highlights, writing or figures in this zone. Blend scene into this dark space smoothly between x44% and x50%. Never mirror this layout. Keep perspective coherent.
Style: premium polished dimensional adult 3D character illustration matching the references, richly tailored realistic fabrics, restrained physically plausible metallic details and cinematic depth. Professional luxury gaming campaign, elongated elegant adult proportions, nuanced expressive face, clean anatomy, subtly animated film polish, not a children's cartoon.
Brand garment detail: only tiny elegant gold letters "NB" stitched directly into Max's LEFT chest (viewer-right). Underneath NB leave a clear smooth patch of matching coat FABRIC, without any design or border, so an exact official shield can later be added there. No invented shield, no placeholder, no nameplate, no rectangle, no badge, no lapel pins. Keep this chest fabric unobscured by hand or scarf. NB is the sole permitted writing anywhere.
Global avoid: NO interface, headings, buttons, marketing copy, watermarks, floating lettering, XP, game logo, oversized foreground coins/chips, giant objects, anatomical distortion, cropped legs, cropped hair, short legs, duplicated fingers, hard vertical split. No skin-revealing attire; all are adult characters. Mostly midnight/royal blue with appropriate wardrobe variation, white and restrained red, understated gold light.

Scene/backdrop: cinematic royal-blue and gold Egyptian temple concentrated on the right, midnight stone, slender gold-edged columns, a distant cobalt-lit arch and subtly engraved walls without readable hieroglyphs. Max wears a royal-blue embroidered formal long coat with elegant restrained gold trim, coordinated blue tailored trousers, blue patterned waistcoat, ivory neck cloth, polished BLACK shoes. Pose: attentive small guiding gesture with one relaxed open hand close to his waist, other arm at ease, a warm clever smile; unobstructed left chest. Secondary cast: the same Egyptian queen from images 4–5, white and blue draped gown, blue-gem gold diadem, long black hair, placed further back around x58%; a dark gold-accented ANUBIS CARVED FIGURE/statue further back around x88%, modest in size and soft focus. Max is the clearest and largest character. Blue ambient light with faint warm gold architectural glows.
visible_garments: Royal-blue long coat with gold embroidery and gold lining
assets.pose: Warm small smile, viewer-left hand in trouser pocket, viewer-right hand extended open in a guiding invitation.

background_figures.placement: Behind Max at left, white/blue gown and blue-gold diadem
background_figures.visible: Complete figure apart from natural overlap with Max; gown extends to approximately x42%.

background_figures.placement: Behind Max at right, dark stone with gold accents
background_figures.visible: Full statue with floor/platform; softly focused.

chest_emblem.location: Max's left chest, viewer-right, directly below NB
chest_emblem.measurement: Visually measured on magnified exact-original chest-area excerpts; final placement should be checked with the exact official shield.

deviations: Max occupies approximately 95% of image height, larger than the requested 75–82%, while full hair and both shoes remain inside the frame.
Queen gown and architecture enter x42–44%; the page's left navy gradient can cover this.
A small dark rectangular fabric panel/pocket with a stitched border was generated directly below NB. It is not the official shield and remains in the unmodified original.
Guiding gesture is wider than requested.
assets.mobile_crop_note: All of Max remains inside the x44.4–100% crop. The queen's far-left gown hem is slightly cropped; face, torso and main silhouette remain visible.
